Electronic Sign Request Form The message sign located in Bigelow Park is intended to provide messages that have a community-wide benefit. The sign is available to governmental groups, 501(c)(3) organizations, youth groups and other non-profit organizations directly impacting the greater Johnstown community. Any use for private business, for-profit organizations, commercial messages, political candidates or issues, or religious messages is prohibited. Permissible messages include, but are not limited to, the following: community event messages, government and organizational meetings, weather alerts and public safety or service announcements. The fee to display a message will be $5.00 (effective May 1, 2019) and may be displayed for up to two weeks prior to the event.
